description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to remote connections within the Thunder RPC namespace, including the Environment struct, IRemoteConnection interface, and iterator type definitions.

classes.name: Environment
classes.description: Represents an environment variable with a key, value, and scope (local or global).

classes.name: IRemoteConnection
classes.description: Interface for managing remote connections, including methods for acquiring interfaces, terminating, launching, and posting mortem data.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for remote connection event notifications, including activation, deactivation, and termination events.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Template method to acquire a specific interface type from the remote connection.
